responses.short_answer_ko: 논문은 수주·제안 KG 구축 사례가 아니라, 장문 한국어 업무 문서에서 evidence-grounded procedural KG를 추출하는 constrained IE task로 정의한다. 현재 RQ1-RQ4, M1-M11, CQ/query pack, paper section source map이 이 framing을 뒷받침한다.
responses.short_answer_en: The paper should be framed as constrained evidence-grounded procedural KG extraction from long Korean enterprise documents, not as a one-off bid/proposal KG case. RQ1-RQ4, M1-M11, the CQ/query pack, and the section source map currently support that framing.
responses.safe_claim_boundary: Task definition, method modules, and structural diagnostics are safe to discuss now.
responses.must_not_claim: Do not claim final target-corpus superiority until human-gold scoring is complete.
responses.remaining_gate: human-gold annotation, IAA, adjudication, and proposed-method scoring

responses.reviewer_question: 데이터가 공개되지 않으면 재현성이 낮지 않은가?
responses.short_answer_ko: raw OCR/source text는 권리 검토 전 공개하지 않는다. 대신 schema, prompts, evaluation scripts, provenance, public-safe synthetic examples, public benchmark adapters, release bundle manifest를 공개 가능한 재현성 package로 제시한다.
responses.short_answer_en: Raw OCR/source text should not be released before rights clearance. Reproducibility is mitigated through schemas, prompts, evaluation scripts, provenance, public-safe synthetic examples, public benchmark adapters, and release-bundle manifests.
responses.safe_claim_boundary: Public-safe reproducibility scaffolding is claimable as setup evidence.
responses.must_not_claim: Do not state that private source text can be redistributed or that rights review is complete.
responses.remaining_gate: external rights review before public source-text release

responses.short_answer_ko: 차별점은 ontology guidance 자체가 아니라 CQ-anchored schema retrieval, procedural node/edge schema, component evidence spans, validators, active-review queue, NCS/PCF standard bridge를 하나의 평가 가능한 pipeline으로 묶는 데 있다.
responses.short_answer_en: The novelty claim should not be generic ontology guidance. It should focus on combining CQ-anchored schema retrieval, procedural node/edge schemas, component evidence spans, validators, active-review queues, and NCS/PCF standard bridging in an evaluable pipeline.
responses.safe_claim_boundary: Method composition and artifact coverage are safe to claim.
responses.must_not_claim: Do not claim that each module independently improves final quality until ablations are scored against human gold.

responses.short_answer_ko: 이 데이터는 OCR noise, 장문 절차, 한국어/영어 alias 혼합, task-artifact-role-flow가 얽힌 업무 문서라는 IE challenge를 제공한다. 현재 5,009 sentence OCR evidence index와 120 evaluation chunks, 100 priority review chunks가 준비되어 있다.
responses.short_answer_en: The corpus is motivated as an IE challenge with OCR noise, long procedural context, mixed Korean/English aliases, and intertwined task-artifact-role-flow structures. The current setup includes 5,009 OCR evidence sentences, 120 evaluation chunks, and 100 priority review chunks.
responses.safe_claim_boundary: Dataset challenge and sampling setup are safe to describe.
responses.must_not_claim: Do not claim benchmark quality or annotation reliability until annotation and IAA are complete.

responses.short_answer_ko: CAPE-KG는 prompt만이 아니라 strict JSON contract, schema retrieval, constrained predicate set, component evidence spans, ontology/SHACL validation, procedural diagnostics, provenance lock으로 통제된다.
responses.short_answer_en: CAPE-KG is controlled by more than prompts: strict JSON contracts, schema retrieval, constrained predicates, component evidence spans, ontology/SHACL validation, procedural diagnostics, and provenance locks constrain the pipeline.
responses.safe_claim_boundary: Engineering controls, validators, and provenance are safe setup claims.
responses.must_not_claim: Do not equate strict JSON or SHACL pass rates with final semantic correctness.

responses.short_answer_ko: 평가는 node/edge F1, evidence EM/IoU, unsupported edge rate, ontology conformance, procedural consistency, CQ answerability, mapping P@K/MRR/nDCG로 정량화되도록 준비되어 있다. 현재 final human-gold 값은 pending이다.
responses.short_answer_en: The evaluation is designed around quantitative metrics: node/edge F1, evidence EM/IoU, unsupported edge rate, ontology conformance, procedural consistency, CQ answerability, and mapping P@K/MRR/nDCG. Final human-gold values remain pending.
responses.safe_claim_boundary: Metric definitions and scorer readiness are safe to describe.
responses.must_not_claim: Do not report silver/proxy diagnostics as main human-gold performance.
responses.remaining_gate: completed human-gold labels and scorer refresh

responses.short_answer_ko: NCS/PCF는 핵심 NLP contribution이 아니라 downstream standard-taxonomy alignment task로 제한한다. core contribution은 evidence-grounded procedural IE이고, NCS/PCF mapping은 KG가 표준 taxonomy alignment에 유용한지 검증하는 후속 평가다.
responses.short_answer_en: NCS/PCF mapping should be scoped as a downstream standard-taxonomy alignment task, not the core NLP contribution. The core contribution is evidence-grounded procedural IE; mapping evaluates whether the resulting KG helps standard-taxonomy alignment.
responses.safe_claim_boundary: Candidate generation and downstream task framing are safe to discuss.
responses.must_not_claim: Do not claim P@K, MRR, nDCG, accept-rate, or utility until expert review is complete.
